semantic_reason_registry.normative_condition: The named one-dimensional ordered pre-owner parse, canonical, structural, consensus, chain, fee, DA-identity, or integrity check rejects and no narrower reason applies.

An outer local lifecycle gate or selected detached DA owner may return before pending-outpoint reserve; Section 5.1 stable guard/context or DA-owner unavailability selects existing Section 6.5 UNAVAILABLE with zero effect.
The exact shared-owner reservation finds the input already owned by the other retained domain.

An exact retained DA_COMMIT_TX or DA_CHUNK_TX replay is peer-neutral; an otherwise-valid same-txid nonexact candidate reaches duplicate/first-seen determination after its owning validation and is peer-neutral; only a fully validated different-txid DA_COMMIT_TX for the same da_id applies the existing negative duplicate-commit peer-quality effect to REMOTE_P2P; LOCAL_RPC returns HTTP 409.
CB18.5 step 8 cannot preallocate or preflight one exact final result before the final DA lock.
The completing candidate loses the exact CB18.4 comparator, including equality.
The post-reservation final exact live image or token recheck differs from the planned snapshot.
A selected resident record or its accounting fails required integrity before capacity publication.
A selected victim lacks a required member, locator, or claim.
Configured DA mempool bytes are outside 536870912 through 4294967295 and startup rejects.
The next accepted sequence would exceed u64 max before mutation.

Section 5.1 copied retained evidence that is dangling, corrupt, or retained-identity-mismatched selects existing Section 6.5 INTERNAL with zero effect; other bound malformed or inconsistent owner, index, or accounting evidence remains fail-closed when no narrower reason applies.
